notes: Fictional regression cases only. They exercise harness mechanics and cannot complete the Step 18 experiment, which needs the frozen development protocol from Step 09/16 and an approved provider run.

The LLM judge receives the same shortlist the retriever produced (equal evidence), ordered by entity_id, with each record's display name and all aliases in alias_id order, and without baseline scores or the baseline's chosen alias, so baseline rank is not leaked. Retrieval misses are counted separately.

partition must be allowed for the reference set; packaged-synthetic-v1 allows only fictional-regression-only, and every report over it is regression_only. A live run also needs live.approved_partition equal to partition.
target_entity_ids lists every fictional record sharing the intended name; an empty list marks an absent query.
